subject.title: fix(onboarding): skip setup for configured gateways and require inference first

question: After the correctness and security blockers are resolved, should this combined onboarding, plugin-API, dependency, and migration branch land as one unit or be split into independently reviewable changes?
rationale: The branch spans 350 files and several compatibility and trust boundaries, so test results alone cannot determine whether maintainers intentionally accept the combined upgrade and review blast radius.

options.title: Split independent surfaces
options.body: Separate profile-migration, plugin/dependency, and onboarding work where their validation and rollback boundaries do not require one atomic change.

options.title: Accept the combined migration
options.body: Keep the branch unified only with explicit owner approval and exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, security, and dependency proof for every changed boundary.

recommendation.title: Split independent surfaces
recommendation.body: Separate profile-migration, plugin/dependency, and onboarding work where their validation and rollback boundaries do not require one atomic change.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the branch, is assigned to the PR, and has recent current-main history across the central affected paths.
